INSERT INTO auction ( seq, name, bid_open_price, image, end_date, description, created_at, status, winner_seq, create_member_seq, category_seq ) VALUES ( #{dto.seq}, #{dto.name}, #{dto.bidOpenPrice}, #{dto.image}, TO_DATE(#{dto.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), #{dto.description}, default, '0', null, #{mdto.seq}, #{dto.categorySeq} )
mapper.select: select a.*, c.name as categoryName, m.id as sellerName from auction a LEFT OUTER JOIN category c ON a.category_seq = c.seq INNER JOIN member m ON a.create_member_seq = m.seq where a.seq = #{_parameter}
select a.*, (select max(bid_price) from bid_history b where b.auction_seq = a.seq and b.status = 0) as highestBid from auction a where a.seq = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: insert into bid_history (seq, bid_price, bid_time, status, member_seq, auction_seq) values (bid_history_seq.nextVal, #{bidPrice}, default, 0, #{memberSeq}, #{seq})
mapper.select: SELECT b.seq, b.auction_seq, b.member_seq, b.bid_price, b.bid_time, b.status, m.id AS userId FROM bid_history b INNER JOIN member m ON b.member_seq = m.seq WHERE b.auction_seq = #{_parameter} ORDER BY b.bid_time DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: update bid_history set status = 1 where auction_seq = #{seq} and status = 0
UPDATE auction SET status = 3 WHERE seq = #{seq} AND create_member_seq = #{memberSeq} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bid_history WHERE auction_seq = #{seq} AND status = 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.*, ROWNUM as rnum FROM ( SELECT a.*, c.name as categoryName, (SELECT max(bid_price) FROM bid_history b WHERE b.auction_seq = a.seq AND b.status = 0) as highestBid FROM auction a LEFT OUTER JOIN category c ON a.category_seq = c.seq WHERE a.create_member_seq = #{memberSeq} ORDER BY a.seq DESC ) s ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.*, ROWNUM as rnum FROM ( SELECT a.seq as auctionSeq, a.name, a.image, a.end_date as endDate, m.id as sellerName, c.name as categoryName, -- 카테고리 이름 조인 (SELECT max(seq) FROM bid_history WHERE auction_seq = a.seq AND member_seq = #{memberSeq}) as bidSeq, (SELECT max(bid_price) FROM bid_history WHERE auction_seq = a.seq AND member_seq = #{memberSeq}) as myBidPrice, (SELECT max(bid_price) FROM bid_history WHERE auction_seq = a.seq AND status = 0) as highestBid FROM auction a INNER JOIN member m ON a.create_member_seq = m.seq LEFT OUTER JOIN category c ON a.category_seq = c.seq WHERE a.seq IN (SELECT DISTINCT auction_seq FROM bid_history WHERE member_seq = #{memberSeq}) ORDER BY a.end_date ASC ) s ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}
mapper.update: UPDATE auction SET status = 1, end_date = SYSDATE, winner_seq = ( SELECT member_seq FROM ( SELECT member_seq FROM bid_history WHERE auction_seq = #{seq} AND status = 0 ORDER BY bid_price DESC, bid_time ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) WHERE seq = #{seq} AND create_member_seq = #{memberSeq} AND status = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bid_history WHERE auction_seq = #{seq} AND status = 0)
mapper.select: SELECT winner_seq as "winnerSeq", create_member_seq as "sellerSeq", (SELECT max(bid_price) FROM bid_history WHERE auction_seq = a.seq AND status = 0) as "bidPrice" FROM auction a WHERE seq = #{_parameter}
